surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
Open the tar archive. For each member, reject and return False if it is a symbolic link or hard link, including links whose declared targets appear to remain inside the destination; regular files and directories may still be extracted after validation. For each regular file or directory, join its archive path to dest_path, normalize the resulting path, and verify it remains strictly beneath dest_path; if validation fails, return False without extracting that member. Extract only validated regular files and directories. Return True if every member is successfully validated and extracted; otherwise return False.
END_PLAN
